milestones.title: Shared load & controller tracking
milestones.scope: Measure throughput at 16 / 64 / 256 parallel environments under shared load; check tracking with the same controller.
milestones.acceptance: Record measured throughput and controller tracking before selecting the rollout configuration.
milestones.result_note: Complete with a declared FD limitation: 16 / 64 / 256 environments measured 877.744721 / 3,393.919703 / 12,829.080117 env-steps/s; per-world sim/wall was 0.45715873 / 0.44191665 / 0.41761331. All use the same frozen N03/HSM GPU PhysX + Fabric rigid-body workload, 100 warmup + 1000 timed-prefix steps, no render, one shared-load run each. This is not completed tasks/s. Valid 4 / 16 / 64-env process peaks were 4,931 MiB; 256-env peak was 5,061 MiB with 10,002 MiB minimum free and no guard stop. A fixed-overhead model replaced the earlier proportional overestimate, followed by staged measurements. The failed 1-env initialization (0 native steps) remains retained and is excluded from the model. B1 actual tracking passed across 16 Panda worlds: worst position RMS/max 4.1217 / 6.0730 mm and orientation RMS/max 0.81688° / 1.25805°; command and actual speed/acceleration exceedances were 0. Acceleration limiting affected 50,142/403,200 joint-steps (12.4%); speed limiting was 0. The clock recorded 3,600 callbacks / 30.000001565 native s, wall 529.614 s. The original full local FD gate remains false at far-origin x≈22 / 30 m in float32, alongside the independently passed tracking diagnostic; all three earlier failures remain retained.

milestones.title: State-driven, re-entrant experts
milestones.scope: Start with N03 / N12. Each expert must resume from the current observed state rather than depend on a one-way script.
milestones.acceptance: Centered 4×4 task domain: pass a native TCP Jacobian preflight at the same thresholds first; then 20 nominal episodes and 50 real mid-trajectory rollout-state takeover tests per task. State-driven experts must match prior nominal success before takeover.
milestones.result_note: Candidate 2: N03 and N12 each completed 20/20 nominal episodes. Independent NPZ audits passed continuity, case-ID and native-clock checks; each task contains 14,000 active transitions with continuity error 0. Candidate 1’s N03 result (0/20) remains retained. N12’s first 16-state takeover batch STARTED at 2026-10-21T10:42:23.122861+00:00; N03’s first 16-state batch has started. Neither task has a final 50-state takeover result. Timing is fixed at 2 / 5 / 9 / 17 / 22 s, 10 states per time; each task uses 25 noisy-expert proxy states and 25 random-action interruptions, with no state reset at takeover. Passive raw velocity/contact/clock logging was added without changing the 41D observation, 8D action or physics. Existing nominal raw verifier evidence is absent: training admission and learning updates remain 0.

methods.name: Oracle
methods.role: Oracle reference; report separately from learned policies.

methods.name: Multi-task BC
methods.role: Behavioral cloning from the matched expert-label budget.

methods.name: OPD (user method)
methods.role: Student rollout → task-expert labels → sample/label-validity verifier filter → failure/recovery weighting → K rounds. Verified failure/recovery segments may be admitted; episode success is not the admission criterion.

opd_loop: Verifier filter for sample / label validity

evaluation.name: First-attempt success
evaluation.protocol: At least 50 episodes per task and method; report numerator, denominator and 95% Wilson interval.

evaluation.name: Failure recovery
evaluation.protocol: Report recovery from the declared pushes, slips and observation delay.

evaluation.name: Attempts 1 / 2 / 3 / 5 + slope
evaluation.protocol: Report success by attempt and improvement slope. Keep frozen-weight evaluation separate from test-time updates.

evaluation.name: Expert-label budget
evaluation.protocol: Plot measured performance against expert-label budget for each matched method.

evaluation.name: Verifier admission / rejection
evaluation.protocol: Data-boundary evidence only: N03 and N12 nominal each queried 14,000 active labels; all 28,000 are training-rejected for missing per-tick raw verifier evidence, with 0 admitted. Four boundary regressions passed; task-level verifier acceptance remains open. Verified failure/recovery segments remain eligible independently of episode success.

disclosures: This page describes the approved phase-2 plan and a dated local evidence summary.
A completed expert reliability measurement does not establish learned-policy performance, recovery capability or a phase-2 milestone pass.
No OPD learning curves or policy success scores have been measured in this snapshot.

Nominal task success and measurement integrity are separate from training admission. Current nominal traces lack raw per-tick verifier evidence; training admission is 0. Four data-boundary regressions do not establish task-level verifier acceptance.

Ma is complete with its original full local FD-gate limitation declared. All three throughput batches are measured once under shared load. Both task nominal runs are complete; final takeover50 outcomes and trained-policy evaluation remain unmeasured.

throughput.workload: Same frozen N03/HSM workload: GPU PhysX + Fabric, rigid bodies only; 100 warmup + 1000 timed-prefix steps; no render.
throughput.scope: Single shared-load timed prefix; environment-steps/s is not completed tasks/s, isolated hardware capacity or learned-policy training throughput.

memory_model.supersedes: Earlier total-peak proportional extrapolation overestimated larger batches. That conservative admission decision is retained as history; 64 and 256 were subsequently admitted and measured in stages.
memory_model.scope: Measured process peaks and a local admission model, not a general memory-capacity guarantee.

controller_B1.next_step: Centered N03 / N12 native FD preflights passed separately; their takeover evaluation is running.
